video_title: Brandon Miller: Media Got LaMelo WRONG + RJ Predicts FIRST ALL-STAR Year

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on LaMelo Ball's growth as a leader
quotes.excerpt: I feel like the media had him looking crazy a lot of times. His leadership growth was main thing.
quotes.quote: I feel like the media had him looking crazy a lot of times. But I think his leadership growth was the main thing I was excited for him last year. I feel like the media kind of had him looking crazy a lot of times, but I think his leadership growth was the main thing I was excited for him last year.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the difficulty of being a young veteran
quotes.excerpt: It is a disservice when the 23-year-old has to be the vet to the 20-year-old.
quotes.quote: It is a disservice when the 23-year-old has to be the vet to the 20-year-old. Having people that have been through it, that are good vets that understand locker rooms in and out, that is valuable. That is not pressure that you should feel from an infrastructure standpoint. But I am proud that you took that on.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Brandon Miller's potential for an All-Star season
quotes.excerpt: If you are healthy at the start of the season, this year could be your All-Star season.
quotes.quote: The next step for elite players, which I believe you have the ability, if you are healthy at the start of the season, this year could be your All-Star season. The ability to manipulate the game, where it is watching film, it is, hey, this is what this team does. How can I manipulate the game? That is the one thing that is the hardest gap from people being a very good player that is an All-Star three, four years to the guy that becomes a future Hall of Famer.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the difficulty of the Hornets' win total jump
quotes.excerpt: To go from 42 to 50 wins, there is that big gap. You guys have that.
quotes.quote: To go from 19 to 42, and to go from 42 to 50 wins, there is that big gap. You guys have that and I think with your talent, you can lead the way.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on his rookie mentors
quotes.excerpt: I was a rookie with four other rookies. The rookie duties were kind of split.
quotes.quote: I was a rookie with four other rookies. Brian Scalabrine, Jason Collins, and Brandon Armstrong. So the rookie duties were kind of split. But I think that is a good part because it is like if you are a number one pick, even Tim Duncan, ultimate legend, David Robinson would make him buy dinner one time or do. It is part of the fraternity. No matter how good you are, you are on the lowest totem pole. Now don't bully kids, don't be a dickhead, but like, hey, I am going to take care of you nine times out of ten.
